name: docs-layout
title: DocsLayout
description: Documentation shell: top bar · left nav (a NavList) · article · right table of contents. The `Outline` sub-component is the table of contents: scroll-spy with IntersectionObserver (rooted in the article column, guarded where it is missing) marks the heading in view with aria-current="location", and activating a link moves focus to the heading. Below `lg` the nav hides and the table of contents moves into a Collapsible above the article. Fills its container; `fullScreen` switches to `h-dvh`.
author: gntik-ai
